en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a city street with a central fountain in the foreground and historic multi‑story buildings lining the street. A tall baroque church tower with a clock dominates the right side. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and around the square. Printed caption text at the top left reads "Graz. Herrengasse".
